summary: Mako Mining Corp. filed a Form 6-K containing a press release reporting exploration drill results from its San Albino Project in Nicaragua. The release details high-grade gold intercepts (e.g., 26.98 g/t Au over 6.8 m) at the Las Conchitas area, which is fully permitted for mining. These results are part of ongoing RC and diamond drilling programs aimed at expanding resources and extending mine life. There are no terms or events related to a special situation such as an acquisition, divestiture, or restructuring; the filing is a routine operational update.
